baseline.detail: Course score is round par plus the stored field-average course expectation. Common weather is the saved round-level common_strokes value (+ = more strokes); player skill and relative weather terms are centered on active model-input players and expressed as score shifts.

course_provenance.coverage_limitations: DPWT 2025/2026 has geometry only; no published shot/round observations in this generation

field_strength.detail: Player skill redistributes expected scores around the course anchor. No separately calibrated adjustment for this field's absolute strength versus historical fields is applied.

general_fit.method: PGA par × yardage bands; fixed 3-year recency half-life established on chronological 2023–2025 folds

geometry_quality.history_rule: a false/missing published spatial-validity flag blocks coordinate matching for the full target round; par/yardage layout validated separately

historical_weather.field_adjustment: Historical field strength is not separately normalized in these hole counts.
historical_weather.method: Current weather uses a fitted deviation from venue-typical weather when available, otherwise training-average weather.
historical_weather.note: Historical hole outcomes are not individually weather-neutralized; the weather reference and scoring anchor can differ.
historical_weather.reference: Weather present in the historical hole outcomes

history_completion.rule: published status COMPLETED and verified last round date strictly before target start

course_provenance.physical_match_method: direct target 18-hole exact-par numbered tee/pin match: median<=90ft,p90<=180ft; no event-id or venue-alias pooling; ambiguous source rounds excluded

source_notes: Player and field values are forecasts from verified stored score draws, not observed outcomes; zero scores are inactive and excluded.
Field outcomes average active players within each shared draw, preserving common weather and other draw-level correlation.
The field quantile curve uses empirical inverse-CDF quantiles at 0%, 1%…99%, and 100%; scores are fractional active-field averages, not an integer PMF.
Base skill terms are field-centered; current live terms use their stored engine values, and per-player residuals expose the remaining posterior forecast difference.
